verdict.rationale: A probe reports an official MCP server documented in docs/MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md, and Buzz ships buzz-dev-mcp, a first-party MCP server that 'gives any agent a shell and a file editor'. However, the documented way agents connect to Buzz itself is the ACP harness plus the Buzz CLI, not MCP, so MCP-based access to Buzz workspace features is unproven. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools exposing Buzz channels/repos/workflows, setup/connection instructions for the MCP server, contents of MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md beyond the probe's existence claim, independent or hands-on corroboration.
